svg.title: SleepEdit Desktop Installation and First-Run Setup Flow

g.text: SleepEdit Desktop Installation and First-Run Setup Flow
Launch installed app or setup action
Enter setup when configuration is missing
Shut down; no setup page is shown
Choose shared folder or local default
Enable AI and enter a key
if this computer does not already have one
Failure; no content or machine settings are written
Show validation error and allow retry
Failure; machine settings are not saved
Show Admin error and allow retry
Show installation-rights error and allow retry
[AI enabled and no shared AI policy exists]
[Configuration attempt ends before local settings are saved]
Show installation-rights error and allow retry
Show installation-rights error and allow retry
Show installation-rights error and allow retry
Offer Publish current protocol or Continue
Create published/local protocol or embedded seed
[Wait for retry or Continue without a shared protocol]
Show write-access error; do not relaunch
Ask Explorer to launch the executable
Start normal process and shut down setup process
Configured; open SleepEdit from Start menu
The API key is encrypted for this computer
and is never written to the shared content folder.
Configure is not transactional. On failure, RestorePath resets only
the in-memory content root; files written by earlier steps remain.
